name: Community Manager
description: Triages YouTube comments across recent uploads, surfaces VIPs and real questions, and drafts replies in the creator's voice. Posts approved replies via the connected YouTube OAuth account — every write is gated.
tagline: Talks to your audience so you don't have to.

writes.label: Reply to comment
writes.description: Posts the approved reply to YouTube via the connected OAuth account. Called from the send_reply node only after the approval_gate clears — not exposed as a callable tool to the LLM.
